Everyday Life Surrounded by Puppy Pokémon | Pokémon TCG Pocket
To celebrate the release of the Pokémon TCG Pocket expansion “Everyday Wonders", we’re bringing you a livestream featuring five adorable Pokémon. Take a peek into the everyday lives of these Pokémon as they spend peaceful, ordinary moments together in a cozy home. Enjoy!
